49324.summary: The class discusses the sanctity of marriage as a divine institution, emphasizing the importance of husbands treating their wives with respect and affection, as God views his people. It also explores the virtuous woman described in Proverbs 31, encouraging wives to emulate her qualities and husbands to support their wives in their spiritual growth.

49325.summary: The class discusses the qualities of a godly husband, emphasizing the importance of God being the life of the marriage. It draws from Proverbs, 1 Peter, and Isaiah, highlighting the responsibilities of husbands to love, honor, and understand their wives, and the mutual dependence in marriage.

49326.summary: The class discusses the sacredness of marriage, emphasizing the importance of fidelity and the responsibilities of husbands and wives to each other and to God. It draws from Psalms 127 and 128, highlighting the blessings of fearing God and the importance of unity and obedience within the family of God.
